comparison.objective: Tip a push mower onto its side with the air-filter side up to expose the blade without contaminating the intake.
comparison.physical_skill: Whole-object reorientation, balance control, and semantic side selection.
comparison.success_condition: Mower rests on the correct side with blade access and filter side up. Oil-flow and stability thresholds are unavailable.
comparison.reason: This tests safe orientation of a heavy intact object, not precision impact fracture or recovery of small released components.
